text.start:
GnomeVPN — a fast VPN with no speed limits.

YouTube in 4K, social media, games. Works on iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS and TVs.

To link this chat to your account, open the Telegram tab on the site and press Connect Telegram. A code appears — send it here.

No account yet? Sign up on the site: the first day is free.
text.linked:
Done — this chat is linked to your account.

Everything is here now, on the buttons below.
text.alreadyLinked: This chat is already linked to an account.
text.codeInvalid:
That code did not work — it is unknown, already used or expired.

Get a new one on the site: the Telegram tab.
text.notLinked:
This chat is not linked to an account.

Open the Telegram tab on the site, press Connect Telegram, and send the code here.
text.unlinked: Chat unlinked. Your subscription and access are untouched — you can come back any time.
text.noSubscription:
No subscription yet.

Press Free day to try it, or Subscribe to start right away.
text.linkIntro: Your subscription URL. Copy it and add it to the app:
text.linkWarning: Do not forward this link: it is the credential to your subscription. If it leaks, rotate it on the site.
text.choosePlan: Pick a term. The longer it runs, the cheaper the month:
text.trialGranted:
Your free day is live 🎁

Press Connect to get your link.
text.trialUnavailable:
The free day has already been used — it is given once.

Press Subscribe to get a subscription.
text.trialNeedsEmail: Confirm your email address on the site first — the message is already on its way to the address on your account.
text.checkoutIntro: Pay at the link below. Access opens the moment the payment clears:
text.inactive:
No active subscription.

Press Subscribe to turn your access back on.
text.help:
The buttons below do everything the commands do:

🚀 Connect — your link for the app
📊 Subscription — expiry and devices
🎁 Free day — twenty-four hours, on us
💳 Subscribe — extend your access
🌍 Language — switch language

Unlink this chat — /unlink

Something broken? Write to support on the site.
text.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
